channel.title: The Grant Desk - AI, Tech & Research, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: AI, Tech & Research, Australia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: Screen Australia Future Leaders Delegation: BitSummit 2027 (Kyoto)
item.description: Screen Australia · deadline 05 Nov 2026 · AUD 6,000 per delegate towards flights, accommodation, event tickets, ground transportation and meals, plus covered travel costs for the pre-departure workshop and the opportunity to exhibit a game on the Australia stand. Up to eight delegates.

item.title: ANAT: Synapse Residency Program 2027 (Australia)
item.description: Australian Network for Art and Technology (ANAT) · deadline Closed 14 Oct 2026 · Total artist fee of AUD 19,250 ex GST plus 12% superannuation, plus up to AUD 3,500 toward other project expenses. No application fee.
